title: Reasoning routine for each job or market event
summary: A repeatable decision procedure that prevents impossible yet cheap proposals, fabricated prices and optimistic savings claims.
invariants: Always distinguish mandatory constraints from preferences.
Each cost comparison must use equivalent job completion guarantees, time window and cost perimeter.
An opt-in model cannot silently replace the default tariff profile.
No single cheapest number without detailed assumptions and exclusion reasons.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: 1. Classify job intention, outcomes, capabilities, data locality, hard deadlines and mobile/checkpointable/partitionable semantics.
2. Request hard eligibility/admission and destination proof from native systems; retain exact object and authority references.
3. Fetch timestamped verified price terms; label fixture, public, authenticated and available-capacity evidence separately.
4. Enumerate complete single-node, multi-node/fabric and stay/migrate plans consistent with actual semantics.
5. Calculate billed duration, minima, quanta, startup, storage, transfer, checkpoint, risk and expected completion.
6. Compare against a declared unmanaged-equivalent baseline; record exclusions and uncertainty.
7. Choose RUN, HOLD, MOVE-ADVISORY or NO-ELIGIBLE-PLAN subject to deadlines and budget.
8. Write a paper receipt only for paper commitments; do not treat status as financial settlement.
9. Re-evaluate when prices, leases, policy, execution status or forecasts change; apply anti-churn limits.
10. Report actual savings only after external metered charges and valid counterfactual evidence reconcile.
